messages:
maria: Quick proposal: add a Preview+Leash flow for org-level runtime defaults. Preview shows heatmap + top affected tenants before any write.
dan: +1. Must include dry-run estimator and an opt-in replay using hashed tenant sampling.
oliver: Sampling impl: sha256(tenant_id) % 100 < sample_pct. Stable and easy to reason about.
maria: API sketch: POST /v1/configs/preview -> returns preview_id, affected_count, estimator_summary, and CI.
ux-bot: UX note: show estimator CI, a CTA to run full sample, and a linkable preview share URL.
dan: Safety: auto-pause if p95 delta > 40ms OR error_rate +0.4% OR tokens +8% for 3 consecutive minutes.
oliver: On apply, auto-generate reversal config and attach it to rollout metadata; allow one-click revert.
ops-bot: hook: on_threshold -> create_incident('auto-pause'), attach runbook draft, ping @ops.
maria: Audit: store immutable preview snapshot and replay outputs in S3 + emit audit event.
dan: Tests: unit for estimator math, replay integration using synthetic traces, e2e for apply->pause->revert.
ux-bot: I'll mock the preview canvas and timeline. Sending link shortly.
maria: Thanks — will start the API spike this afternoon and loop everyone in the PR.
